units.title: Health, Safety and Environment in Tiling and Decorative

learning_outcomes.description: Execute health, safety, and Environment on construction sites applicable to tiling/stone decorative works

performance_criteria.description: Identify health, safety and welfare measures in construction sites relating to tiling and stone decorative works
Apply health and safety regulations relating to tiling/stone decorative works.
Carry out activities in a safe and responsible manner in accordance with standard guidance and manufacturer’s instruction.
Demonstrate how to report accidents and emergencies to appropriate personnel such as; • First Aiders • Supervisors/Managers • Health and Safety workers

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate the use of personal protective gears

performance_criteria.description: Use clean and smart PPE in accordance with instructions.
Report accidents and emergencies to personnel such as; • First Aiders • Supervisors/Managers • Health and Safety workers
Clean and store PPE appropriately after use

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure personal health and hygiene

performance_criteria.description: Summarize own responsibility under the health and safety Act as it relates to own occupation
State general rules on hygiene that must be followed.
Identify the use of Personal Protection Equipment such as Head, Foot, Face & Eye, Hand, and Body protection gears among team members.
Explain the importance of maintaining good personal hygiene.
Describe how to deal with cuts, bruises, and wounds and why it is important to do so.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure a hygienic, safe and secure workplace

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of working in a healthy, safe and hygienic workplace .
Report any accident or near accident quickly and accurately to the authorized person.
Follow health, hygiene and safety procedures during work.
Describe emergency procedures during work
Follow organizational security procedures.
Use disposal of waste and pollution control with organic and inorganic waste disposal methods.
Recognize sound/ noise control and protection methods and guidelines.

learning_outcomes.description: Prevent hazards and maintain safe & secure workplace.

performance_criteria.description: Identify any hazards or potential hazards and deal with it.
Describe the types of hazards in the workplace that may occur and how to deal with them.
Monitor safe lifting and handling techniques that should be followed
State ways of working safely that are relevant to own position and why they are important
Analyze organizational emergency procedures and how it should be adhered strictly to
State the possible causes of fire in the workplace.
Describe how to minimize the possibility of fire in the workplace.
Describe organizational security procedures and why these are important.
Describe the importance of reporting all usual and non- routine incidents to the appropriate personnel.

learning_outcomes.description: Use complex communication systems in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Use verbal means to pass on necessary information.
Use written means to pass necessary information such as quotation, specifications, request for approvals etc.
Interpret symbols and signs appropriately.

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise the use of various information sources in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Locate the source of information in the work environment
Monitor the use of various information flow systems in a work environment.
Use instructions in line with ethics of the work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate the use of various means of communication in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Observe the various communication equipment in the work environment
Use the various communication equipment in a work environment in accordance with instructions.
Pass information to the right personnel in accordance with instructions.
Pass information using symbols, signs and codes.
Recognize instructions in line with ethics of the work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Develop Positive working relationship with colleagues

performance_criteria.description: Explain the importance of positive working relationships with colleagues.
Monitor team members in accordance with instructions.
Report to the personnel request for assistance in accordance with instructions.
Communicate with colleagues about own work that might affect others.

learning_outcomes.description: Take responsibilities within the team

performance_criteria.description: Explain own role and responsibilities within the team.
Perform individual tasks in line with the team rules and regulations.
Supervise team members in accordance with instructions.

learning_outcomes.description: Comply with policy of organization.

performance_criteria.description: Identify rules from code of conduct relevant to own trade area
Investigate in line with organizational policy
Observe organizational code of conduct.

learning_outcomes.description: Analyze drawings with mathematical methods.

performance_criteria.description: Carry out basic mathematical operations such as addition, multiplication etc
Use fractional methods to solve practical problems
Add, subtract, multiply and divide with fractions and decimal fractions

learning_outcomes.description: Determine angles when cutting tiles according to the size of the angle

performance_criteria.description: Measure angle on tiles/stone required for cutting.
Measure and cut as many different angles as possible.
Use large wooden or plastic protractor to measure angles.

learning_outcomes.description: Calculate surface area of floors and walls

performance_criteria.description: Determine area of wall surface in square meter (m2)
Assess area of floor surface in square meter (m2)
Measure perimeter of given rectangle in meter as 2(L+B)
Compare different shapes using relevant formulas

learning_outcomes.description: Calculate volume and surface areas of three- dimensional objects.

performance_criteria.description: Measure volume of various shapes
Describe volume of a bedroom, sitting room, convenience e.t.c
Calculate areas of floors, walls in a room

learning_outcomes.description: Estimate quantity of tiles/stone from the working drawing

performance_criteria.description: Use any working drawing of building, i.e. residential or educational.
Interpret the drawing for to locate the area to be tiled or stonework
Calculate the area to be tiled or decorated with stone
Estimate the quantity of sand and cement required.
Estimate the quantity of adhesive/mortar required.
Request for all materials as required.

learning_outcomes.description: Allow for waste when estimating

performance_criteria.description: From drawing, evaluate actual quantity required.
Allow at least five percent (5%) for waste from cutting fraction.
List ways of minimizing waste

learning_outcomes.description: Evaluate cost of project from working drawing

performance_criteria.description: Calculate the area from drawings
Prepare quotation of materials e.g. Fine aggregate, cement, adhesive, white cement etc.
Order for materials as required.

learning_outcomes.description: Organize mixing for adhesives for Tile work

performance_criteria.description: Organize materials for mixing adhesives
Prepare position for mixing adhesives according to mechanical or manual methods
Monitor the measurements of materials to specification
Observe the mixing of adhesive according to requirements

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise the laying of tiles to level and alignment

performance_criteria.description: Interpret the working drawing to locate area to lay the tiles/stones
Supervise setting out the area to receive tiles/stones
Supervise the selection of the tiles required according to size and color.
Cut any fraction to size using an appropriate mechanical cutter.
Supervise the soaking of tiles to absorb initial water to prevent tiles from absorbing water from the mortar.
Lay tiles to standard using adhesives.
Ensure tiles are laid, leveled and aligned including all fractions.
Lay the tiles to the final level.
Supervise the grouting of the joints using adhesives.
Supervise the cleaning of tile surface and work area.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure tile joints and surfaces are aligned and flat

performance_criteria.description: Inspect tile joints as work proceed to ensure bond and joint alignment are even
Use line, straight edge and level as work proceed in accordance with instructions.
Evaluate each joint line before proceeding to the next level in accordance with instructions.
Monitor tiling for wall and floor as required to the final point.

learning_outcomes.description: Fix and lay mosaic tiles

performance_criteria.description: Measure area to receive mosaic tiles.
Select the color and pattern of mosaic required.
Calculate the surface area to receive mosaic.
Select mosaic tiles and required fixing adhesives
Fix mosaic in position.
Ensure joints are filled.
Ensure the selected pattern is the designed pattern.
Ensure it is set, aligned and truly flat on the wall or floor

learning_outcomes.description: Confirm that grouted joints are straight and uniform in width

performance_criteria.description: Confirm joint alignment is straight.
Confirm joint width are uniform
Organize to fill joints width with grout, i.e slurry or thick cement liquid
Organize to clean excess grout on mosaic tiles

performance_criteria.description: Monitor the corners to receive the tiles
Organize tools required to cut tiles into fractional sizes for corners
Analyze materials required for tile laying of corners

learning_outcomes.description: Cut tiles into various fractional sizes.

performance_criteria.description: Measure the tiles required for the corners.
Carryout cutting of tiles to various fractional sizes.
Monitor the fractional tiles fit into their position

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise the fixing of the corner tiles

performance_criteria.description: Observe mix the required mortar in accordance with specifications.
Observe Soaking of tiles in water.
Use mortar to on the tile surface
Monitor that tiles are in accordance specifications.
Carry out the grout of the joints in accordance with specifications.
Guide the cleaning of the working area and tile surface

learning_outcomes.description: Organize tile work on curved surfaces

performance_criteria.description: Determine the work position from the working drawings
Ensure tiles are prepared for the position.
Estimate quantity of tiles required

learning_outcomes.description: Set out the tile work as required.

performance_criteria.description: Set out the curved surfaces by checking the layout of the tiles
Mark the position of tiles on the curve.
Organize materials and tools as required.

learning_outcomes.description: Fix tile to curved surfaces

performance_criteria.description: Measure and cut tiles for curved surface.
Erect tiles using approved mortar.
Monitor the curve is uniform in accordance with specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise preparation for laying of decorative stones

performance_criteria.description: Identify the positions in stonework decoration.
Justify the decorative stonework to be laid.
Prepare adhesives (mortar) in accordance with specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Organize work for decorative stone construction

performance_criteria.description: Monitor the work position from the working drawings
Calculate the quantity of stones required
Supervise the selection of the required decorative stones.
Monitor the Setting-out of the foundation in accordance with specifications.
Cast Monitor the foundation in concrete casting in accordance with specifications.
Use the required tools to dress the stonework
Use mortar the dressed stones in accordance with specifications.
Assess the grout joints and clean work environment in accordance with Instructions.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure stone joints and surfaces are aligned and flat

performance_criteria.description: Monitor stonework for even bond and joint and alignment.
Evaluate joints line before proceeding to the next layer in accordance with instructions.
Compare stonework as required to the final finish point in accordance with specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise the repair and maintenance of tile/stone laid surfaces

performance_criteria.description: Rectify damaged tiles or stonework area by chiseling.
Calculate the total area of tiles or decorative stonework to be replaced.
Carry out cleaning of the area for tiles/decorative stonework removed

learning_outcomes.description: Supervise the selection of tiles/stones for replacement.

performance_criteria.description: Determine the quantity of tiles/stonework and adhesives required for the replacement
Selection of tiles/stonework to be replaced according to color.
Organize to Monitor mixing of adhesive/cement grout to be used for re-fixing the tiles.

learning_outcomes.description: Fix tiles/stones to damaged area.

performance_criteria.description: Erect the tiles/stonework in accordance with specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Explain project planning and coordination

learning_outcomes.description: Plan basic activities required for tiling/decorative stonework

performance_criteria.description: Identify the project drawings.
Determine the area to be tiled/laid with stonework
Estimate and prepare quotation to include prices of material and labor
Organize and arrange tools/equipment and materials
Monitor the tiling/decorative stonework.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply inspection procedures for tiling/stonework

performance_criteria.description: Monitor the job site, check alignment and cleanliness in accordance with specifications.
Observe cracks or lifting of tiles/stonework from surfaces
Evaluate the quality of materials.
